 TicketConsumed = Ticket definitely not usable any more. The ticket has been used and cannot be used any more after the given date and time.

id.description: unique id of the ticket within the context of ticket delivery

TicketAppLinkAnnotationDef.description: Annotation liking the ticket to a specific app and providing additional control tokens to be validated via a double singned barcode (DOSIPAS according to TAP TSI B.12).

replacedId.description: id of a app link annotation to be replaced by this link

appId.description: identifier of the app. The identifier will be presented via the second level data of a bar code. It identifies the app, not a dedicated instalation of the app.

validationToken.description: list of tokens whic might be provided via the second level data in a barcode. All tokens must be hashed to ensure that the token can not be used to identify a person or Phone accross multiple tickets.

type.description: type of the token. Prefefined: UIC_PHONE_ID (a hashed value of a phone identifier e.g. the IME), UIC_E_PASS_ID (a hashed identifier from an electronic passport to be read by the app (on demand at control time))

supportsChallenge.description: the TCO can ask the traveller to insert a challenge code in the app to be included in the level two data of the dynamic bar code.

serviceBrand.description: restriction  to a specific service brand

includedServiceBrand.description: either the included or the excluded list of service brannds can be used, not both at vthe same time.
